## Où j'en suis
Built the SRE take-home — docker compose, a planted broken alert rule, a connection leak and an over-broad IAM policy — plus a 4-area rubric, and moved the whole exercise into its own private repo `kestrel-analytics/sre-take-home` via a subtree split so candidates never see the infra history. The work is essentially finished (3 commits on the exercise repo) and waits on Thursday's call; nothing has been sent to the candidate.

- [en-cours] `hiring/` deleted from the working tree on `maya/sre-take-home` but not committed, since the branch will be dropped.
- [prochaine-étape] After the Thursday 4pm Tel Aviv call, Maya sends the exercise and invites the candidate to the repo herself.
- [essai-raté] Multi-arch `buildx --load` fails ("docker exporter does not currently support exporting manifest lists"), and the prebuilt image was amd64-only; compose now builds `flaky-svc` from source.
- [décision] No Kubernetes, 3-hour cap, Terraform + compose only (source: t03)
- [décision] No pass threshold: scores feed the panel, with Noa as second reviewer (source: t10)
- [décision] Nobody emails the candidate; Maya sends it herself (source: t16)
